TINY WORLD / PHASE 1 SCALE REVIEW

All eight designs are static concept artwork, not functional pixel sprites or interchangeable PNG layers. These views resample the same illustrated figure into a 144 × 144 concept cell, then enlarge that exact cell 3× with nearest-neighbour sampling.

Proposed feet anchor: y=130. Character heights follow the approved study targets; wolf and dragon sizes are provisional. Native here means the proposed asset cell, not verified screen size in the latest game. No animation, production palette, transparency or integration is claimed.

Concept review only. Scale reduction exposes lost fine detail; production pixel clusters and camera angle still require refinement. No game code or saved-world data changed.
